USER DECISION B, where each part went:
  (1) Device -> FEAT-003 item 14.
      --device auto|cuda|cpu plus TrainingConfig.training_device='auto' (insert-only; read only by the runner; the CLI wins).
      resolve_device: cuda without CUDA is fatal. device_scope('cpu') hides CUDA only while the trainer is built, because every component picks its device at construction; it is a no-op on CPU machines and the trainer is not edited.
      device_record verifies the trainer, loss engine, text encoder and projection devices and writes lc_manifest.device. lambda_pilot --device forwards the flag. preserved_rng also saves and restores CUDA RNG states.
  (2)/(3) -> FEAT-004 item 22 (sweep.py): forward --device to the runner and evaluator subprocesses, plus the remote driver plumbing. Not implemented here.
  (4) -> new scripts/go_withholding/regenerate_conditions.py (+ test_regenerate_conditions.py).
      One command, no pin appended. It verifies the base files against G1, the table against G2-targets, and the validation set against G2-validation (staged, moved into place only on a match). Each condition's in-memory manifest sha is checked against G3 BEFORE writing; build_condition then writes or verifies it idempotently.
  No absolute paths:
      The literal ROOT asserts were removed from withholding_constants and the 4 FEAT-002 scripts. New helpers: ROOT_TOKEN '$ROOT', expand_root_token, root_token, config_path_problems, expand_config_dict, load_study_config, scrub_root, relativize_json, rel_to_root, lambda_choice_path.
      The runner accepts '$ROOT/...' or absolute config values and still rejects bare relative ones (so the design 4.2 step 1 test holds); CLI overrides must be absolute. lc_manifest, run_error, lambda_choice and the audit JSONs are relativized.
      FEAT-002 emitters fixed: frozen_hashes.raw keys (and so the G1 pin), convert_manifest paths, the pruned pickle's meta obo_path/gaf_path and leak_audit inputs are all repo-relative. Pins hold hashes only.
      Design-text deviation (design not edited): 4.2 step 1 and 12.1 said 'absolute'; '$ROOT' anchoring keeps the same fail-closed intent.
